name: unsafe fn get_unchecked (self , slice : * const T) -> * const Self :: Output
rule: The index `self` must be in bounds for `slice` when calling `get_unchecked`; an out-of-bounds index causes undefined behavior even if the returned pointer is not used.
api: trait SliceIndex < T : ? Sized > : private_slice_index::Sealed { unsafe fn get_unchecked (self , slice : * const T) -> * const Self::Output }
